cards.title: The Refresh Cycle

cards.title: Charge drains in milliseconds
cards.sub: a capacitor is never a perfect bucket

cards.title: Read it before it fades
cards.sub: the amplifier resolves a faint charge into a clean 1 or 0

cards.title: Every row, every 64 ms
cards.sub: read, amplify, write back. then the next row.

cards.title: Refresh takes bandwidth
